COST: 240

Notes on the plan:
- Only myagang-shelter and uttargaya-hospital are evacuation points. Tadi temple is not designated, so nobody is dropped there.
- The bidur-farm and trishuli-farm group is cut off: the Tarkeshwar care home road to Suryagadhi temple is buried, so these three adults are deferred (3 × 20 = 60).
- The Likhu temple to Jwalamukhi market road is avoided because of fast floodwater, and the Uttargaya hospital to Likhu temple road is blocked.
- The Shivapuri farm to Suryagadhi temple road is also avoided because of flooding.
- The plan assumes each listed road can be driven in either direction.
- Driving totals 180 minutes (car1: 114, car2: 66), plus 60 in penalties.
